tasks.short: Conduct agricultural research and publish findings.

steps.what: Retrieve agricultural literature and study records, retaining full scientific reading
outputs: verified source set and scientific reading

steps.what: Conduct actual agricultural research and interpret findings
inputs: verified source set and scientific reading
actual field, laboratory or analytical observations
outputs: actual methods, results and chosen interpretations

steps.what: Draft manuscript passages from actual methods, results and interpretations
inputs: actual methods, results and chosen interpretations

loop.input: actual methods, results and chosen interpretations
loop.check: Check every scientific claim, omission, citation and causal implication against actual research
loop.stop: Missing sources or two failed checks return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native manuscript sections first; variable scientific prose still requires contextual drafting

steps.what: Check final manuscript, author permissions, destination and publication route
inputs: actual author permissions and publication requirements
outputs: checked final manuscript and exact authorised destination

steps.what: Submit final research manuscript to the chosen journal or book publisher
inputs: checked final manuscript and exact authorised destination

steps.what: Publish final findings through authorised electronic media
inputs: checked final manuscript and exact authorised destination

tasks.design: Configure native research-source links in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}; retain actual agricultural science and complete manuscript checking. Source-bound prose support precedes separately gated publisher submission or {CMS} publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and expression of established results repeat work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and checked prose assistance can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Agricultural variability, experimental validity and causal interpretation require scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes a supported finding from a seasonal or sampling artefact.
tasks.altitude: More time for actual research and interpretation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source links and prose drafting can support manuscripts; actual agricultural research and publication decisions remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares, not measured baselines. Source retrieval savings exclude full scientific reading. Actual primary data collection and analysis are retained in s2.

Journal/book submission and own-media publication are alternative routes: remove unused route and reweight. Journal submission does not imply acceptance; revisions require a new full check. Any actual record save or separate publication approval is its own final-version action with no savings assumed.
Native functions first; existing functionality earns no new saving. Shared research/manuscript preparation counted once.
unknowns: Which publication route and source systems are actually used?
research_questions: Does checked drafting save effort after full scientific verification?

incremental.description: Maintain source access and audit scientific drafting errors.

approvals.approved_version: s4 final manuscript, author permissions and exact publisher destination; edits void check
s4 final manuscript, publication rights and exact electronic destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40 + 15*0.30 = 10.5 gross; deduct 1.5 upkeep once. Low halves eligible savings. Actual science and publication actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose crop production, plant genetics or soil chemistry objectives and scientifically valid examples
inputs: actual cohort needs and scientific sources
outputs: chosen lecture content and verified examples

steps.what: Assemble lecture notes using chosen content and reusable native course sections
inputs: chosen lecture content and verified examples

steps.what: Check complete final lecture notes, scientific meaning and course destination
outputs: checked final lecture notes and course destination

steps.what: Save final lecture notes
inputs: checked final lecture notes and course destination

steps.what: Deliver lectures and respond to actual undergraduate or graduate questions

tasks.design: Use native reusable lecture sections in {DOCS} and {LMS} after the teacher chooses valid agricultural content. Retain full final checking, a separate save, actual teaching and responses to students.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated lecture structure can consume preparation effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable sections can assemble selected material.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining crop, genetics and soil mechanisms for an actual cohort requires judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher detects misunderstanding and changes the explanation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course sections can reduce lecture assembly; they do not replace actual teaching.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Existing reusable-section use yields zero new saving. Chosen sources and all scientific checking remain human.

Actual lecture materials shared with task 5776 are counted once. Any actual learner publication is a separate final-version gated action, assigned to materials preparation where owned; no saving assumed for it.
unknowns: How much lecture assembly remains manual?
research_questions: Do native sections reduce preparation after complete checking?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final lecture notes and course destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.40=8 gross minus 0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Teaching, checking and save retained.

tasks.short: Collaborate on agricultural teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Retrieve and verify actual teaching or research issues and relevant decisions
Collaborate with colleagues to resolve actual teaching and research issues
Capture and check assigned actual collaboration decisions and owners
Save final assigned collaboration decision record

tasks.design: Configure native issue and source links in {PROJECT}, {LMS} and {DOCS}. Retain actual collaboration, assigned new decision capture, full checking and a separately gated save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding dispersed actual issues can repeat navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links can bring actual source records together.
tasks.still_hard: Colleagues must resolve competing teaching and research needs.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native issue links can assist preparation; they do not establish colleague agreement.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Colleagues produce actual issue records; missing details require retained inquiry. Existing links yield zero new saving.
Record only where actually assigned; omit unused branch and reweight. Any actual separate written delivery gets its own final-version gated send with no savings assumed.
unknowns: Does the teacher own a decision record?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final assigned decisions and record destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10*0.40=4 gross minus 0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All collaboration and new record work retained.

tasks.short: Prepare agricultural course syllabi, assignments and handouts.

steps.what: Choose syllabus requirements, agricultural learning content and assignment solutions
inputs: actual scientific sources and cohort needs
outputs: chosen course requirements, content and verified solutions

steps.what: Assemble syllabi and homework using native approved course sections
inputs: chosen course requirements, content and verified solutions

steps.what: Draft handout explanations from chosen scientific content
inputs: chosen course requirements, content and verified solutions

loop.input: chosen scientific content and verified solutions
loop.check: Check scientific meaning, omissions, answer validity and accessibility against chosen sources
loop.stop: Missing sources or two failed checks return to manual drafting
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed sections first; variable explanatory prose requires contextual drafting

steps.what: Check complete final syllabi, homework, handouts and learner destination
outputs: checked final course materials and exact learner destination

steps.what: Save final course materials
inputs: checked final course materials and exact learner destination

steps.what: Release checked final course materials to the actual learners
inputs: checked final course materials and exact learner destination

tasks.design: Configure native syllabus and assignment sections in {LMS} and {DOCS}, then assist only variable explanations grounded in teacher-chosen science. Retain complete checking before separate saves and learner release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fixed course structures and explanations can require repeated composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sections and source-bound drafting can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific accuracy and fair, useful assignments need teacher judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher checks whether a task teaches and assesses the intended agricultural concept.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course sections and checked prose drafting can assist materials preparation.

assumptions: Provisional shares, not observations. Native functions first; existing use earns zero new saving. All scientific choice and solution checking retained.

Count shared lecture/material preparation once across 5779 and 5776. Internal-only learner communication uses the organisation's internal release authority rather than external publication; exact final-content gate remains. Remove unowned release branch and reweight.
unknowns: Which sections are reusable without scientific change?
research_questions: Does checked drafting reduce total preparation effort?
